heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly cloudy south, and clouds decreasing north. Highs in the low to mid 70s north, mid 70s to around 80 south. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Clear to partly cloudy, becoming mostly cloudy late in the north. Lows in the low to mid 50s, with some upper 40s northeast. Winds becoming light, variable to southeast, except south to southeast 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of a morning shower north, then likely in the afternoon from the Champlain Valley westward, a rising chance elsewhere north of Route 4, and a chance to the south; thunder possible. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, some upper 70s far south. South winds 5 to 15 mph and gusting 25 mph in the St. Lawrence Valley, and gusting to 35 mph in the Champlain Valley.
